The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families. The Waste Logistics Expert plays a central role in our waste logistics operations, acting as a high-level specialist and the primary deputy for the Waste Logistics Manager. In this capacity, you will ensure that all waste disposal processes are safe, compliant, and efficient while actively contributing to the optimization of our logistics and sustainability goals. The role of this person is to serve as a vital support function within waste management, maintaining high-quality services that meet the expectations of various stakeholders, regulatory requirements, and operational targets. You will be responsible for a broad scope of different facilities. The hired candidate will act as a key interface between operational logistics, production plants, laboratories, strategic growth projects, safety departments, and the supply chain. You will assist in ensuring that our facilities meet long-term sustainability objectives and strictly adhere to GMP and safety standards. They will also act as a proactive problem solver, identifying operational challenges early and initiating measures to ensure Business Continuity through alternative disposal routes and data-driven process improvements. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OBoAVhfTkTQ This role is primarily based on site. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards. We offer flexibility to work remotely for no more than 20% of your time. Requests are considered on a case‑by‑case basis, in line with business needs. What you will get:
• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.
• An inclusive and ethical workplace.
• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.
• In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. Our full list of tailored local benefits can be found below. Benefits in Visp: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi What you will do:
• Take operative and strategic responsibility for waste-related activities across different facilities
• Ensure strict adherence to all relevant GMP, safety, and environmental regulations, including performing detailed risk assessments.
• Act as the central point of contact for internal teams (Production, EHS, Engineering) and external waste disposal partners.
• Monitor the "disposability" of materials and secure alternative disposal paths to prevent operational bottlenecks.
• Standardize cross-functional waste processes and leverage technology or data-driven approaches to improve efficiency.
• Control KPIs, generate detailed reports, and derive actionable improvement measures to promote recycling and sustainable solutions.
• Support and represent the Waste Logistics Manager in strategic projects and daily management tasks. What we are looking for:
• Degree in Chemical/Pharma Technology, Environmental Engineering, Biotechnology, Waste Management, or a comparable qualification (alternatively, extensive practical experience in a similar environment).
• Minimum 10 years of experience in chemical or biopharmaceutical production or long-term operational experience in high-complexity logistics.
• Deep knowledge of safety standards (SECO, SUVA, EKAS), GMP guidelines, and the handling of hazardous materials.
• Experience with ERP and logistics systems such as SAP, TrackWise, Syncrotess, or similar tools.
• Advanced IT and data analysis capabilities, particularly with MS Office, PowerBI, and modern reporting tools.

jobs.title: Laboratory Associate Commercial Quality Control 80-100%
jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Basel Stücki, Switzerland.

What you will get

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

What you will do:

• Perform basic operational tasks in the lab (e.g mobile phase preparations, calibration of pH meter, balance check).

• Ensuring cleanliness and tidiness in the laboratory. This includes adherence to 6S principles and to cGMP standards for audit readiness

• Perform analytical testing within DPS Commercial QC (cGMP) for batch release and stability studies of drug products under cGMP according to existing method SOPs

• Document assay performance following Good Documentation Practices (GDocP) and flag relevant observations to the supervisor for further assessment

• Following applicable EHS regulations

What we are looking for:

• Training as lab technician (e.g. EFZ, CTA) or BSc in Analytical Chemistry, Biochemistry or related field

• Willingness to learn and grow

• Experience working in a GMP-regulated QC laboratory is a plus

• Experience with HPLC, CE-SDS, icIEF, or ELISA is a plus

• Understanding of cGMP, GDocP, and Data Integrity principles

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

About Lonza
